title: Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest - 1-up
description:
The sound effect that plays when you get a 1-up balloon in DKC2/3.

MOD NOTE: This adds four new instruments (a total of 0x24 bytes) to the SFX instrument table, which is global.
